title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Bethel Woods Center for the Arts, Bethel | 2012
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Bethel Woods Center for the Arts, Bethel, New York, USA, on 16 June 2012.

It was the third show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 26 dates in June and July 2012.

Starr had previously performed at the Bethel Woods Center for the Arts on 26 June 2010. He returned there on 16 August 2019.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
